messages:
anya: Heads-up — pulling together a 10-seat preview cohort for next Tue/Wed. Need volunteers to help with seat curation, onboarding cadence, and a 30m enablement run. Also want a lightweight feedback loop so PMs can triage regressions quickly. Who's in? :wave:

mike: I can own the enablement session (30m live + recording). Will build a 15-slide deck + quick demo. Prefer Tue morning.

liz: I can do seat curation and invite copy. Can we prioritize 3 accounts with high renewal risk so CSMs can try retention playbook? Suggest: BlueLoom, Fathomix, and HoloMed.

anya: @liz yes please prioritize that list — mark them as "high-touch" in the sheet. Also want 4 more seats for self-serve customers to validate onboarding flow.

dylan: I can stitch together the feedback capture form and small prompt-eval harness. I'll post the form link here and wire it to a Google Sheet. Quick question: do we want quantitative scores (ease + value) or just freeform?

anya: both — 1–5 ease/value + 1 freeform field. Keep it <5 questions. Use this tag for triage: #preview-urgent when customers report functional regressions.

sam-support: added a reminder: @here onboarding checklist + link to recording will be auto-sent 1h after session. Also set up a small CS triage rota for the first 48h.

onboard-bot: Reminder set: schedule enablement session on 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC. Invite created for 10 attendees.

mike: Draft agenda uploaded: https://docs.google.com/preview-enablement (comments welcome). Also adding a 5m segment on "what good looks like" to capture expected outcomes.

dylan: Form + sheet: https://forms.goo.gl/preview-feedback -> responses sheet will be at https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/preview-feedback-sheets. I added a sample CSV export below for the triage view:

```
account,cs_owner,score_ease,score_value,freeform,reported_blocker
BlueLoom,anya,4,3,"UI confusing on model selection","no"
Fathomix,liz,2,2,"latency spikes on long prompts","yes"
HoloMed,mike,3,4,"overall good, docs missing examples","no"
```

anya: perfect. @dylan can you add a computed column for "risk_flag" if score_value <=2 or reported_blocker == yes? We'll use that to page the CSM on call.

dylan: yep will add that and a filter view called "triage-48h".

liz: on invites — I'll send tailored email for the 3 high-touch customers and a bulk invite for the remaining 7. Copy below, feel free to tweak:

"Hi <name>, we'd love to invite you to a short preview of our new integration. 30m session + recording. We want help shaping the experience and will follow up with a short feedback form. Let me know if you'd prefer an asynchronous walkthrough."

anya: looks good. Last ask: can someone own a short renewal-risk note per high-touch account after the session? 5 bullet summary for AE + CSM. @liz?

liz: I can draft the 5-bullet notes and send to AEs within 24h.

anya: awesome — thanks team. Plan summary:
- Seat curation: @liz (high-touch list + invites)
- Enablement: @mike (10am UTC Tue, recording + deck)
- Feedback capture + triage sheet: @dylan (form + risk flag + triage view)
- Reminders + auto-send: @sam-support
- Renewal notes: @liz (post-session 24h)

If anything slips, ping me or post in #preview-ops. :rocket:
